title: Yoniso
text: 2. -yad idaṃ yonisomanasikārasampadā || || 3. Yonisomanasikārasampamassetam bhikkhave- || pe () || -maggam bahulīkaroti || || 4. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti || la (pe) || sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ dosa- mohavinayapariyosānaṃ || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhave yonisomanasikārasampanno ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāveti ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bahulīkarotī ti || || {Ekadhammapeyyālaṃ} || || {Tassuddānaṃ} || || Kalyāṇamittaṃ Sīlañca || Chando ca Attasampadā || Diṭṭhi ca Appamādo ca || Yoniso bhavati sattamaṃ || || EKADHAMMAPEYYĀLO II. 1. Sāvatthinidānam || || I. VIVEKANISSITAṂo
